verdict.rationale: Each agent gets an isolated Git worktree and branch, so file changes stay separate from the main checkout. User-defined setup/teardown scripts can install dependencies, move env variables, and spin up branching services per worktree. However, the docs state that worktrees do not sandbox processes, so keeping production data out of reach depends on the user's own scripts and configuration. Missing for 10: process or runtime sandboxing, a first-party sandbox or test-data environment, documented safeguards keeping agents away from production data, independent hands-on corroboration.
